summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of KarikaBooth. Backend: 16 pytest tests over all 9 endpoints (root, event-logo upload/status/image/delete, caricature with event logo + custom logo + validation errors, creations list, image serve, soft delete) - all 16 passed, including 2 real Gemini generations returning exact 1200x1800 JPEG with logo composited. Frontend: attract screen, settings logo upload/remove/re-upload with toast + preview, camera-view -> photo-file-input fallback -> confirm view (logo pills, event logo pre-selected) -> real generation -> result-view (data:image/jpeg base64, natural dims 1200x1800), print (window.print stubbed, print-area img loaded 1200px, page stayed alive), download/new-photo/gallery buttons, gallery grid (3 items, all thumbs loaded) + detail modal with print/download + close, and mobile 390x844 with 0px horizontal overflow on attract and confirm views. No console/page errors, no 4xx/5xx observed.

minor.issue: Object-storage I/O uses the blocking `requests` library directly inside async endpoints (put_object/get_object/init_storage), which blocks the FastAPI event loop for the duration of every upload/download. Wrap in run_in_threadpool/asyncio.to_thread or use httpx.AsyncClient.

No size/dimension validation on the incoming image_base64 (any decodable base64 is accepted, even non-image or huge payloads). A non-image passes validation and only fails later inside Gemini/PIL, and an oversized payload is forwarded to the LLM. Also no rate limiting on a paid LLM endpoint.
Hard-coded to_list(100) with no pagination; at a live event the gallery silently caps at 100 items.

content_type read from storage is discarded and response is always image/jpeg (harmless today, misleading if other types are stored); no Cache-Control headers so gallery thumbnails are re-fetched from object storage on every render.

issues: The 2:3 result image renders only ~445px wide, leaving huge empty gutters, while the 4 action buttons stretch to ~780px each in a 2-col grid - visually unbalanced. Consider constraining the button grid to the image width / a max-w container.

All content is left-aligned with the entire right half empty (kiosk-portrait oriented). Acceptable for a booth, but on wide desktop it looks unfinished; a max-w centered layout or right-side visual would balance it.
Thumbnails use object-cover on aspect-2/3 with no dark overlay/label; generated caricatures are quite dark so a subtle border/gradient or created_at label would improve scanability. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional: offload blocking `requests` storage calls off the event loop (asyncio.to_thread) in /app/backend/server.py.
Optional: validate that image_base64 decodes to a real image and cap its size in /api/caricature; add pagination to /api/creations.
Optional design polish: constrain result-view action button grid width on large desktop viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py put_object/get_object/init_storage use synchronous requests inside async route handlers - blocks the event loop for every image read/write (worst case 120s timeout). Use asyncio.to_thread or httpx.AsyncClient.
/api/caricature has no payload size / real-image validation and no rate limiting, so a malformed or oversized upload still consumes an LLM call.
storage_key is a module-level global mutated without a lock; concurrent re-init on 404 can race. Low risk at booth scale but worth a lock.
Frontend handleGenerate assumes customLogoB64 is non-null when logoMode === 'custom'; UI currently guarantees it, but a null guard would prevent a runtime TypeError if that invariant changes.
seed_data_creation: 3 real caricature creations exist in DB (2 from backend tests, 1 from frontend flow); 1 was soft-deleted by the delete test. Event logo is set to a synthetic cyan TEST_logo.png (restored at end of backend suite so frontend/logo flows work). Test images at /tmp/test_face.png and /tmp/test_logo.png generated via conftest helpers.
test_credentials: N/A - app has no auth; /app/memory/test_credentials.md is an empty template.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v` (all tests in one class so xdist loadscope keeps them sequential and order-dependent: logo upload -> generation -> delete logo -> restore logo last). IMPORTANT: each run makes 2 real Gemini calls (~8s each) and costs credits - use `-k 'not caricature_with'` to skip generation. Frontend: headless browser does NOT show the camera-error toast (getUserMedia appears to succeed with a fake device); use hidden input [data-testid=photo-file-input] via set_input_files for the capture step. Full flow verified end-to-end; no open bugs.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. Only non-blocking robustness/design observations listed above.
